sloka: स मुष्टिनिष्पिष्टविकीर्णमूर्धा निर्वान्तदन्ताक्षिविलम्बिजिह्वः।देवान्तको राक्षसराजसूनुर्गतासुरुर्व्यां सहसा पपात ।। ६.७०.२६ ।।
transliteration: sa muṣṭiniṣpiṣṭavikīrṇamūrdhā nirvāntadantākṣivilambijihvaḥ।devāntako rākṣasarājasūnurgatāsururvyāṁ sahasā papāta ।। 6.70.26 ।।

translations.english: Devanthaka's skull was shattered by the blow, and his teeth, eyes and tongue were forced out, the son of Rakshasa king fell dead on the ground.
